blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deleteCustomers` method. This belongs to the Customer Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method deletes a customer by its ID.
